articleBodyHtml:
Introduction to the Speaker's Technology Struggles

The speaker has encountered several challenges with technology, particularly with Apple products. One notable issue involved an Apple Watch, which required a specific charger that the speaker initially did not have on hand. This led to a trip back to the office to retrieve the necessary charging equipment.

The speaker also faced difficulties with the companion's interaction with technology. The companion has a history of damaging electronics and has a tendency to break things she touches. This has led to frustration and a belief that the companion may not be compatible with technology.
